records.issue_text: db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:25 — The migration interpolates stored host text directly into SQL without quoting, so a quote in existing configuration can break the migration or alter the SQL.
records.rationale: Line 25 of the migration interpolates stored host values directly: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, category_id, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"` with no quoting/escaping. A single quote in a migrated `embeddable_hosts` setting value would break the SQL and fail the migration; this is a verifiable defect introduced by the diff.
